name: ENCRYPTED_POSTGRES
description: Attach to PostgreSQL databases with automatic client-side encryption and decryption. All data transferred between DuckDB and PostgreSQL is encrypted using AES-256, protecting sensitive information in transit and at rest.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: PostgreSQL server hostname or IP address

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Name of the PostgreSQL database to attach

parameters.name: encryption_key
parameters.description: Base64-encoded AES-256 encryption key for data encryption

parameters.name: ssl_mode
parameters.description: SSL connection mode (disable, require, verify-ca, verify-full)

examples.description: Attach an encrypted PostgreSQL database using connection parameters
examples.code:
-- Attach encrypted PostgreSQL database
ATTACH 'secure_db' (
  TYPE ENCRYPTED_POSTGRES,
  host 'db.example.com',
  database 'production',
  user 'analytics_user',
  password 'secret123',
  encryption_key 'base64_encoded_key_here=='
);

-- Query encrypted data
SELECT * FROM secure_db.users LIMIT 5;
examples.output: Database attached successfully. All queries automatically encrypt/decrypt data.

examples.description: Use with DuckDB secrets for credential management
examples.code:
-- Create secret for PostgreSQL credentials
CREATE SECRET pg_creds (
  TYPE POSTGRES,
  host 'db.example.com',
  user 'analytics_user',
  password 'secret123'
);

-- Attach using secret reference
ATTACH 'secure_db' (
  TYPE ENCRYPTED_POSTGRES,
  secret pg_creds,
  database 'production',
  encryption_key 'base64_encoded_key_here=='
);

name: ENCRYPTED_MYSQL
description: Connect to MySQL databases with transparent encryption layer. Provides client-side encryption for all data transfers, ensuring sensitive information remains protected even when the MySQL server is compromised.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address

parameters.name: database
parameters.description: Name of the MySQL database to attach

name: VAULT_DB
description: Attach to databases using credentials dynamically fetched from HashiCorp Vault. Eliminates hardcoded credentials and provides automatic credential rotation, audit logging, and centralized secret management.

parameters.name: vault_token
parameters.description: Vault authentication token or AppRole credentials

parameters.name: secret_path
parameters.description: Path to database credentials in Vault (e.g., secret/data/postgres/prod)

parameters.name: refresh_interval
parameters.description: Credential refresh interval in seconds for automatic rotation

examples.code:
-- Attach with AppRole for service authentication
ATTACH 'analytics' (
  TYPE VAULT_DB,
  vault_addr 'https://vault.company.com:8200',
  vault_token 'role_id=xxx&secret_id=yyy',
  secret_path 'database/creds/analytics-role',
  db_type 'postgres',
  refresh_interval 1800
);
